status: fixed-epoch multi-seed invariant temporal screen; not official competition scores

config.status: pre-registered before any multi-seed or RoPE result is observed
config.purpose: audit seed sensitivity and test temporal RoPE under a fixed training budget

training.objective: standardized one-step invariant-feature MSE with teacher forcing
training.checkpoint_policy: final epoch for every architecture and seed; no validation epoch selection
training.parameter_policy: all models below 10k trainable parameters; counts reported

controls.static: repeat structural state and set the four future step-magnitude features to physical zero before standardization
controls.position_ablation: absolute sinusoidal Transformer versus otherwise comparable RoPE Transformer

promotion.primary: mean T1/T2/T3-weighted validation rollout RMSE across seeds
promotion.seed_consistency: beat paired MLP in at least 2 of 3 seeds
promotion.memory_signal: beat mean MLP weighted RMSE and mean Static in at least two scenarios
promotion.long_history_signal: improve mean T2 or T3 RMSE over MLP by at least 5%

config.evidence_boundary: 12D invariant proxy only; cannot establish atomic Geo/Phys/Dyn/Stab or official score
